objective: Implement a durable SqliteScarStore in runtime/memory/ so PAEOS institutional memory (scars) survives process exits. Context: ScarStore in runtime/memory/__init__.py is a pure in-memory dict — every scar ever proposed by the EvolutionLayer evaporated at process exit, so no L01-L16 run ever benefited from prior runs' lessons (hallucination notebook Entries 138-142 and backlog/research/PAEOS_DURABLE_MEMORY_RB_v0.1.md). Deliverables: (1) a SqliteScarStore class in a new module runtime/memory/sqlite_store.py that preserves the ScarStore contract exactly — propose_scar (including ScarQuarantined for signatures with fewer than MIN_SIGNATURE_TAGS conditions), match_scars (subset signature match, sorted by id), get_precedent, injected_scars — but persists rows to a SQLite database file given at construction; ids must continue the scar-NNNN sequence across restarts (derive from max existing id); (2) wire it in ops/autonomous_run.py: construct SqliteScarStore(state_dir / 'scars.db') and pass it as SoftLoop's scar_store= parameter so EvolutionLayer (which takes loop.scar_store) writes durably; (3) tests in tests/runtime/test_sqlite_scar_store.py covering: a scar proposed in one store instance is visible in a fresh instance opened on the same file (cross-process persistence), quarantine semantics preserved, match_scars returns identical results to the in-memory store for the same data, and id sequence continues across restarts.
accept: runtime/memory/sqlite_store.py exports SqliteScarStore with the full ScarStore contract, persistent to a SQLite file
tests/runtime/test_sqlite_scar_store.py proves cross-instance persistence, quarantine preservation, and match parity
goal_signature: runtime/memory persistence sqlite scars institutional-memory durability
